command:

id opsadmin

mv -f "$tmp" /etc/cron.allow
restorecon /etc/cron.allow 2>/dev/null || true
stat -c '%n %U:%G %a size=%s context=%C' /etc/cron.allow

cleanup() { crontab -r 2>/dev/null || true; runuser -u opsadmin -- crontab -r 2>/dev/null || true; }

root_rc=$?

crontab -l

ops_rc=$?
printf 'opsadmin_install_rc=%s\n' "$ops_rc"

deny_out=$(mktemp)
printf '%s\n' '* * * * * /usr/bin/true # benchmark-denied-access-check' | runuser -u nobody -- crontab - >"$deny_out" 2>&1
deny_rc=$?
printf 'nobody_install_rc=%s\n' "$deny_rc"
cat "$deny_out"
rm -f "$deny_out"
[ "$root_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$ops_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$deny_rc" -ne 0 ]
